input_oracle.construction: separately frozen extension-field kernel walk and Velu map

independent_verifier.method: exhaustive base-field point actions plus cleared polynomial identities; no division-polynomial construction

positive_checks: retained full map cleared curve identity
normalized scalar map cleared curve identity
scalar map action equals scaled x([t-1]P) on every affine base-field x-coordinate
full map action equals scaled x([t-2]P) on every affine base-field x-coordinate
